verdict.rationale: PayPal exposes broad REST APIs (orders, subscriptions, invoicing, payouts, disputes, webhooks) plus an MCP server and agent toolkit for AI-native/agentic use, suggesting strong API-UI parity for core payment flows. However, some flows are explicitly marketed as 'no-code' web-only (Resolution Center, Payment Links) alongside their API equivalents, and there's no evidence every UI feature (e.g., Pay in 4, Savings, Pools) has a full programmatic equivalent, so parity is not fully confirmed.
